description: Pak Datacom Limited is a Pakistani data-communications operator and a subsidiary of the Telecom Foundation. Incorporated in 1992 and in commercial operation since July 1994, it provides end-to-end data communication through satellite VSAT (SCPC, DAMA and iDirect), terrestrial networks and radio links, and builds networks to individual customer requirements. It is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
headOffice: 3rd Floor, Umer Plaza, Jinnah Avenue, Blue Area, Islamabad, Pakistan
